BrochureContent.Content:
Set along a peaceful and scenic country road just 500 metres from the beautiful sands of Seafield Beach, this impressive four-bedroom detached dormer bungalow enjoys a superb coastal setting within a short distance of the charming village of Quilty on the Wild Atlantic Way. The property benefits from the tranquillity of a countryside location while remaining conveniently close to the amenities and services of the local area, making it an ideal permanent residence or a luxurious holiday home.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, the accommodation is bright, spacious and thoughtfully laid out to suit modern family living. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a generous kitchen/dining area perfect for everyday living and entertaining, a practical utility room, a comfortable living room and a well-proportioned bedroom that offers flexibility for guests, home working or ground-floor living.

Upstairs, there are three further bedrooms, including a spacious principal bedroom with en-suite facilities, together with a well-appointed family bathroom. The dormer design provides excellent natural light and creates a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the home.

Externally, the property is set on a substantial and beautifully maintained site with ample space for outdoor enjoyment. A large detached garage to the rear offers excellent storage, workshop potential or additional space for hobbies and recreational equipment.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey coastal residence in one of West Clare’s most sought-after locations, where stunning beaches, scenic walks and the relaxed lifestyle of the Wild Atlantic Way are all on your doorstep.
